कहानी - Test 13

चरित्र परिचय

1. Maya - 9 years, a girl in a red frock
2. Kabir - 12 years, a boy in a blue hoodie
3. Grandpa - 70 years, white kurta and glasses

पृष्ठभूमि

1. the living room - a sofa, a TV and a window
2. the park - green grass, a swing, a slide

उपकरण

1. kite - a red paper kite

कहानी आरंभ

पहला दृश्य - the living room (Morning)

Maya (excited) „Grandpa, will you fly my kite?“

Grandpa ''Of course! Let us go to the park.''

दूसरा दृश्य - the park (Afternoon)

Grandpa holds the kite and Maya runs.

Maya (laughing) ''It is flying!''

Kabir «Higher, Maya, higher!»
